usage: Current Discovery hero and seven product card illustrations
prompt:
Use case: product-mockup sprite sheet for a physical creative-object gallery. Create ONE transparent PNG contact sheet containing exactly SEVEN isolated product cutouts arranged in a precise 4-column by 2-row grid, with the bottom right cell EMPTY. The overall canvas should be wide, 2:1 aspect ratio. Every cell is exactly one quarter of the canvas width and one half of its height. No text, labels, grid lines, backgrounds, floors or drop shadows outside the objects. True alpha transparency throughout the surrounding space.
Use the five supplied reference images for keychain, chibi woman, vinyl man, cowboy brick figure, and cat lamp respectively. Preserve those five designs. Use the written descriptions for the ivory cat memorial sculpture and alpine fridge magnet. Remove all original environments and create polished consistent studio lighting. Entire objects must stay within their own cell, centered, filling 70% of their cell width/height, with generous empty padding. Never let one object cross a cell boundary.
Top row from left to right:
1. The reference round brown leather keychain with sculptural white dog relief, visible leather strap and metal keyring, entire product.
2. The reference chibi collectible young woman in a black hat, black trousers, lavender shirt, round clear display base, full body.
3. The reference big-headed vinyl collectible man with amber glasses, black jacket and blue jeans, full body.
4. The reference ivory cat memorial sculpture sitting on a round base. Omit engraved lettering, retain sculpture.
Bottom row left to right:
5. The reference brown-hatted western cowboy brick minifigure, full body.
6. The reference glowing ivory cat-head sculptural lamp, compact and softly lit inside.
7. The reference small framed dimensional alpine landscape fridge magnet, tilted very slightly to reveal depth, entire rectangular frame.
8. Completely empty transparent cell.
No additional objects. These are physical miniatures, not living people or animals. Exact 4-by-2 layout is essential for CSS sprite cropping.
notes: Illustrative product concepts. Preserves five supplied references; cat keepsake and landscape magnet are described concept variants. Images are not live AI results.
